scope: Hindi addressee terms by register tier and scenario

asr_reliability.note: Day 2 testing flagged address terms and short honorific words as the least reliably preserved parts of transcription. Runtime use must depend on the later normalization layer rather than ASR output alone.

tier_rules.notes: Use a name alone or a casual vocative; do not inject one when the sentence is natural without it.
Choose a socially appropriate term when gender/relationship is known; otherwise preserve the original wording.
A formal address term is preferred but may be omitted when repeated use would sound unnatural.
At least one appropriate formal address marker must be present and must not be dropped.
Use the actual kinship relation plus जी; a generic formal title would lose warmth and family-role information.
Use the formal term from the service worker's side toward the customer.

elder_relative.selection_note: Select the true kinship relation; never guess one from gender alone.
